Hi All

We are hiring for AI Developer




Location: Bangalore

Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days

Experience Range:2-4 years

Education: Bachelors Degree in Computer Science with AI




JD:

Role: We are seeking a highly skilled AI Developer with expertise in LLMs, Knowledge Graphs, Neo4j, and RAG/GraphRAG systems to design, develop, and enhance an enterprise AI platform that transforms unstructured manufacturing knowledge into a structured, searchable Knowledge Graph.




Mandatory Technical Skills:

Python 3.11+
Ability to write production grade code and quick PoCs
Object Oriented Programming
Ability to read and reason about unfamiliar codebases, choose appropriate data structures, and write testable, maintainable python code
Ability to code Data engineering pipelines.
Artificial Intelligence (AI, LLM)
OpenAI / Azure OpenAI APIs
Prompt Engineering
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG
Embeddings and Vector Search, Chunking
Multi-stage pipeline design
Neo4j + Cypher (MATCH/MERGE, traversal, indexes, Python driver)



Thanks & Regards

Sri Lakshmi B

Senior IT Recruiter-Talent Acquisition Group
